questions.question: What does Psalm 95 invite the people to do?
options: Come, let us sing to the LORD, the rock of our salvation
Come, let us build a house for the name of the LORD
Come, let us go up to the mountain of the LORD
Come, let us reason together and settle the matter
questions.answer: Come, let us sing to the LORD, the rock of our salvation

questions.question: What warning does the psalm give, recalling the wilderness?
options: Soon, when the trumpet sounds, gather to the feast
Now, while it is light, labor in the field
Tomorrow, when the sun rises, go and offer your sacrifice
Today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts
questions.answer: Today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts

questions.question: The psalm calls people to kneel before the LORD, our Maker.
Today, if you hear his voice, do not _____ your hearts.
For he is our God, and we are the people of his pasture, and the _____ of his hand.
